title: A Difficult Year of Sorrow
paragraphs: During what later became known as the Year of Sorrow, the Prophet ﷺ lost both his beloved wife Khadijah and his uncle Abu Talib within a short period, two people who had protected and supported him for years.
While facing this personal grief, he was also dealing with growing hostility from people in Makkah, who felt emboldened once his uncle's protection was no longer standing between them and him.

Despite the weight of losing two closest supporters while simultaneously facing outside pressure, he continued his mission without pausing, trusting that difficulty would eventually be followed by relief.

This period is often studied today as an example of enduring grief and hardship simultaneously, showing that resilience does not mean feeling nothing, but continuing forward despite feeling everything.
